items.title: 貝森特的債券回購構想 讓華爾街美債交易員不安
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)即將公布他針對美債回購的初步計畫，闡明將多大程度上利用擴大後的回購項目，來抑制美債殖利率。然而，這一舉措已讓華爾街交易商感到不安。
市場焦慮的核心在於其政策風格的轉變、缺乏明確指引，以及政策金額設定上的兩難局面。

打破「可預測」傳統 掀主動干預疑慮

貝森特在8月19日於定期例行日程之外突然宣佈，將原定20億美元的買回規模「至少翻倍」，震驚市場。這項舉動打破了財政部長期遵循「定期且可預測」的債務管理原則，引發市場討論其是否正轉向更具主動干預色彩的管理風格。
儘管初期的宣告曾帶動長天期債券價格反彈，但近幾周殖利率又因全球央行緊縮與財政赤字焦慮而再次走高，特別是攸關房貸利率的10年期公債殖利率，已高於上月水準。

買回規模陷入兩難 專家直言策略倉促

貝森特形容買回計畫旨在冷卻市場「升溫的高燒」，但他多次拒絕透露9月10日的具體金額，僅拉高了市場對規模將超過40億美元的預期。市場分析，若買回金額僅有40億美元，恐引發投資人失望並加劇拋售壓力
；但若金額衝高，也可能面臨副作用。
Wrightson ICAP 高級經濟學家Lou Crandall在給客戶的報告中直言：「大幅增加買回金額，等於承認財政部當初根本沒想清楚8月19日倉促做出的決定」。Crandall認為50億至60億美元是合理的起點。
根據 Wrightson 的試算，若將每次買回金額提高至60億美元，20年期以上公債的每季淨發行量將減少約27%；若拉高至100億美元上限，供給更將大幅砍半(約55%)。

缺乏明確路線圖 資金來源未明

除了規模未知，資金來源同樣尚未明朗，市場推測可能發行更多短期國庫券或動用庫存現金。摩根士丹利策略師警告，受限於資金約束，每場操作的上限約落在100億美元。
巴克萊(Barclays)策略師Anshul Pradhan與Demi Hu則指出，財政部甚至可能採取開放式指引(如「每場至少40億美元」)，雖然能保留彈性，卻會讓市場失去明確的路線圖。

關鍵標售前夕 交易員聚焦交換利差

這項消息發布時間緊鄰10年期公債標售前數小時，隔日更有30年期公債標售，大大放大了即時影響。
彭博總體策略師Brendan Fagan分析，交易員將即時消化購買規模，超出預期的操作雖可能暫時推低長天期殖利率，但該規模相對於龐大的美債市場仍偏小；相比於絕對殖利率，30年期交換利差(swap spreads)將能更清晰反映市場對此決策的最終評價。

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉開高震盪走低守住4萬7  量縮小漲77點市場觀望態度濃厚
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market After Hours: Opens Higher, Fluctuates Down, Holds 47,000; Volume Shrinks, Gains 77 Points, Market Cautious
paras: 台股今(9)日開盤在電子權值股領軍下，一度上漲超過442點，盤中在權王台積電(2330-TW)由紅翻黑下，指數一度翻黑，盤面上以面板、光學、塑化表現較佳，金融股則表現較為疲軟，尾盤在權值股回神下，終場小漲77.58點或0.16％，收47,183.36點，守住4萬7千點關卡，成交量再縮減至7,735.06億元。
權值股部分，台積電(2330-TW)開高走低，最後一盤在大單敲進3,360張下、小跌0.2％，收2,465元；聯發科(2454-TW)跌1.8％、鴻海(2317-TW)漲0.2％、廣達(2382-TW)受惠AI伺服器營收爆發，漲4.27％；聯電(2303-TW)漲3.28％。
面板股得利於智慧顯示器衝高，迎接第4季消費性電子出貨旺季，包括友達(2409-TW)、群創(3481-TW)、彩晶(6116-TW)漲幅逾2-3％。
光學股受惠於蘋果發表會明登場，光學鏡頭股多檔期漲，龍頭股大立光(3008-TW)、伯特光(6859-TW)大漲半根停板，玉晶光(3008-TW)漲停板創新高價，聯一光(3441-TW)強漲8.7％，揚明光(3504-TW)、亞光(3019-TW)漲逾3％。
塑化股受惠中東戰事持續延燒，加上進入金九銀十的傳統旺季，與油價高度相關的台塑化(6505-TW)表現最為強勁，開高走高，收漲停板，創近1個多月以來新高價；二線塑化股因基期較低，包括國喬(1312-TW)漲半根停板，亞聚(1308-TW)、台達化(1309-TW)、台聚(1304-TW)、台苯(1310-TW)漲幅超過3-4％，華夏(1305-TW)、台塑(1301-TW)漲2％。
分析師表示，美國本周即將公告CPI指數，將會影響美國聯準會是否升息，關鍵點在於美伊戰爭是否持續升溫緊張，也讓今日原油期貨上揚，加上近日交易量持續縮減至兆元以下，也讓市場資金持觀望態度。展望後市，可觀察台股成交量是否能持續放大量能，建議投資人漲多股票可先行獲利入袋，待拉回後，再逢低進場布局。
paras_en: The Taiwan market opened today (the 9th) led by heavyweight electronics stocks, briefly climbing more than 442 points. Mid‑session, the benchmark TSMC (2330‑TW) turned from red to black, causing the index to dip into negative territory. Panels, optics and plastics performed relatively well, while financials were weaker. In the final minutes, heavyweight stocks recovered, and the market closed modestly up 77.58 points, or 0.16%, at 47,183.36 points, preserving the 47‑thousand‑point threshold. Turnover fell further to NT$7,735.06 billion.

Among the heavyweight stocks, TSMC (2330‑TW) opened higher but fell, ending the session with a large order of 3,360 lots, down 0.2% to NT$2,465. MediaTek (2454‑TW) slipped 1.8%, Hon Hai (2317‑TW) rose 0.2%, and Quanta (2382‑TW) jumped 4.27% on booming AI‑server revenue. UMC (2303‑TW) gained 3.28%.

Panel makers benefited from a surge in smart‑display demand ahead of the Q4 consumer‑electronics shipping season. AU Optronics (2409‑TW), Innolux (3481‑TW) and CTC (6116‑TW) each rose between 2% and 3%.

Optics stocks were buoyed by Apple’s upcoming product launch, with many lens makers posting gains. Leaders Largan Precision (3008‑TW) and Betta Optical (6859‑TW) surged half a board‑limit, while Yujing Optical (3008‑TW) hit a new high on a full‑limit rise. Lianyi Optical (3441‑TW) jumped 8.7%, and Yangming Optical (3504‑TW) and Asia Optical (3019‑TW) each climbed over 3%.

Plastics and chemicals were helped by the ongoing Middle‑East conflict and the traditional “golden September, silver October” season. Petrochemical giant Formosa Plastics (6505‑TW) was the strongest, opening higher and closing at a limit‑up price, a new high in over a month. Second‑tier plastics stocks, starting from lower bases, also rose: Guojiao (1312‑TW) hit a half‑limit rise, while Yaqi (1308‑TW), Delta Chemical (1309‑TW), Taiwan Poly (1304‑TW) and Taiwan Benzene (1310‑TW) gained 3‑4%; Huaxia (1305‑TW) and Formosa (1301‑TW) each rose about 2%.

Analysts note that the U.S. will release its CPI this week, which could influence the Fed’s rate‑hike decision. The key factor is whether the US‑Iran tension escalates, a factor that lifted crude futures today. With trading volume shrinking to below a trillion NT dollars, market participants remain cautious. Looking ahead, observers will watch whether Taiwan’s turnover can sustain higher levels; investors are advised to lock in profits on rallying stocks and consider re‑entering on pull‑backs.

items.title: Snowflake執行長：AI帶動業務飛輪效應 分析師看好未來成長
items.title_en: Snowflake CEO: AI Drives Business Flywheel Effect, Analysts Bullish on Future Growth
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，Snowflake(SNOW-US)未來幾季可能還會帶來更多令人意外的表現，因客戶正持續為額外的AI服務付費。
Snowflake執行長Sridhar Ramaswamy 在高盛(Goldman Sachs)舉辦的論壇Communacopia & Tech Conference接受訪問時表示，「我認為這是AI經歷數季加速發展後的結果，而現在AI正逐漸轉化為Snowflake業務的一種飛輪效應。」
Ramaswamy補充，在目前所謂的「回歸基本面時代」中，雲端資料平台業務已具備加速成長的「所有必要條件」。
他表示，「首先，在軟體工程師人數相同的情況下，現在能做到的事情多很多。」關鍵在於團隊以及每一名工程師如何運用AI，讓自己的工作效率提高。
而在市場拓展方面，情況也發生了重大變化。Ramaswamy指出，像Snowflake這樣的資料平台，與一般人所認知的「應用程式」之間的距離已經大幅縮短。「因為現在我們任何人都可以創造應用程式，真的只需要幾分鐘，頂多幾個小時。」
Snowflake在9月2日公布亮眼的第二季財報。公司營收達15.5億美元，年增35%。其中產品營收大增37%至14.9億美元，創下連續第三季成長加速。
獲利表現也輕鬆超越市場預期。調整後每股盈餘(EPS)年增77%至0.62美元，明顯高於華爾街預期的0.45美元。
這次財報大幅優於預期，主要受到企業快速採用Snowflake生成式AI產品的推動，例如Cortex Code。
強勁的AI需求也促使Snowflake上調全年財測，全年產品營收預估60.7億美元(原先預估58.4億美元)，營業利益率預估14.5%(原先預估13.5%)。
在營收與獲利雙雙大幅超越預期，加上公司上調財測後，Snowflake股價隔日大漲超過20%。截至目前，Snowflake股價今年以來已上漲約55%。
Stifel分析師Brad Reback指出，「隨著Snowflake面前存在顯著的AI/機器學習(AI/ML)產品成長空間，以及這些產品所帶動的核心使用量，我們現在預期，Snowflake未來幾年的年度產品營收成長率將能持續維持在30%以上，高於先前預估的25%以上。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports Snowflake (SNOW-US) may deliver more surprising results in coming quarters as customers continue to pay for additional AI services.

Snowflake CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy said in an interview at Goldman Sachs' Communacopia & Tech Conference that "I think this is the result after several quarters of accelerated AI development, and now AI is gradually turning into a flywheel effect for Snowflake's business."
Ramaswamy added that in the so‑called "return to fundamentals" era, cloud data platform businesses now have all the necessary conditions for accelerated growth.
He said, "First, with the same number of software engineers, we can now do many more things." The key is how teams and each engineer leverage AI to boost their productivity.

In market expansion, the situation has also changed dramatically. Ramaswamy noted that for data platforms like Snowflake, the gap to what people think of as “applications” has narrowed greatly. "Now anyone can create an application in just minutes, at most a few hours."

Snowflake posted a strong Q2 earnings on September 2. Revenue reached $1.55 billion, up 35% year over year. Product revenue jumped 37% to $1.49 billion, marking the third consecutive quarter of accelerating growth.
Profit performance also comfortably beat expectations. Adjusted earnings per share rose 77% year over year to $0.62, well above Wall Street’s forecast of $0.45.
The earnings beat was mainly driven by rapid enterprise adoption of Snowflake’s generative AI offerings, such as Cortex Code.
Strong AI demand also led Snowflake to raise its full‑year outlook, now forecasting product revenue of $6.07 billion (previously $5.84 billion) and an operating margin of 14.5% (previously 13.5%).
With revenue and profit both far exceeding expectations and the raised outlook, Snowflake’s stock jumped more than 20% the next day. To date, the stock is up about 55% year‑to‑date.

Stifel analyst Brad Reback said, "With significant AI/ML product growth opportunities ahead of Snowflake and the core usage driven by those products, we now expect Snowflake’s annual product revenue growth rate to stay above 30% for the next several years, higher than the prior estimate of over 25%."

items.title: 美元武器化反噬美國信用 歐洲多國接力撤回黃金儲備
items.title_en: U.S. Dollar Weaponization Backfires on U.S. Credibility; Multiple European Countries Sequentially Reclaim Gold Reserves
paras: 今年以來，歐洲多國陸續縮減存放在美國的黃金儲備，將部分黃金轉移至歐洲或運回國內。市場分析認為，這波調整反映各國對儲備安全與地緣政治風險的疑慮升高，也凸顯美國日益將美元、國際貿易關係及支付系統工具化，正對自身信譽造成衝擊。
荷蘭央行9月2日宣布，今年3月至8月間，已將約86噸黃金從美國紐約及加拿大渥太華轉移至英國倫敦。調整後，荷蘭黃金儲備存放於紐約的比重，從31.3%大幅降至18.5%；存放於倫敦的比重則由18.1%升至32.1%，顯示其黃金配置重心明顯轉向歐洲。
法國央行今年4月也宣布，已在2025年7月至2026年1月間，完成調整原先存放於紐約聯準銀行的129噸黃金，約占法國黃金儲備總量的5%。
德國則早在2013年至2017年間展開大規模黃金調回行動，累計運回674噸黃金，其中300噸來自紐約、374噸來自巴黎。今年德國國內再度出現要求進一步將海外黃金運回國內的聲音，德國選擇黨更主張，所有存放在海外的黃金都應調回德國。
多位分析人士指出，各國央行調整黃金存放地點，主要考量儲備安全及地緣政治情勢。法國黃金交易機構國民黃金商行總裁施瓦茨表示，過去10年間，各國央行持續重新配置黃金存放地點，美國當前的政治環境，可能促使部分央行轉向其他儲存地。
美國布林克公司執行副總裁安塔爾認為，地緣政治與經濟不確定性升高，加上黃金作為戰略儲備資產的重要性日益上升，共同推動了這項趨勢。
卡達全球問題中東委員會高級研究員施耐德表示，荷蘭轉移黃金的考量，與德國、法國及義大利等國過去10多年的作法相同，目的都是加強對本國黃金儲備的實際控制。隨著美國愈來愈常運用美元、貿易關係及國際支付系統作為政策工具，許多國家的不安也隨之加深。
瑞銀全球財富管理首席經濟分析師多諾萬則指出，提高黃金流動性的作法「並非正常行為」。由於央行通常採取審慎的儲備管理策略，這類調整圍繞「信任」及美國國際聲譽釋放出的訊號，仍相當顯著。
世界黃金協會《2026年全球央行黃金儲備調查》顯示，74%的央行儲備管理者預期，未來5年美元在全球儲備中的占比將下降；84%預期黃金占比將上升，另有45%預計未來一年增持黃金。過去4年，各國央行增持黃金的規模已顯著高於10年前，顯示全球儲備資產配置正在加速改變。
paras_en: Since the start of this year, several European countries have gradually reduced the gold reserves stored in the United States, moving part of the gold to Europe or back home. Market analysts say this adjustment reflects heightened concerns about reserve safety and geopolitical risk, and highlights that the United States increasingly weaponizes the dollar, international trade relations and payment systems, which is damaging its own credibility.

The Dutch central bank announced on September 2 that between March and August of this year it had transferred about 86 tonnes of gold from New York, USA and Ottawa, Canada to London, UK. After the adjustment, the share of Dutch gold reserves held in New York fell sharply from 31.3% to 18.5%, while the share held in London rose from 18.1% to 32.1%, showing a clear shift of its gold allocation toward Europe.

The French central bank also announced in April that it had completed, between July 2025 and January 2026, the relocation of 129 tonnes of gold previously stored at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, amounting to roughly 5% of France’s total gold reserves.

Germany launched a large‑scale gold repatriation program as early as 2013‑2017, bringing back a total of 674 tonnes, of which 300 tonnes came from New York and 374 tonnes from Paris. This year, calls have resurfaced domestically to further bring overseas gold back to Germany, and the German government has taken a stronger stance that all gold held abroad should be repatriated.

Several analysts note that central banks’ decisions to change gold storage locations are mainly driven by reserve safety and geopolitical considerations. Schwarz, president of France’s national gold dealer, said that over the past decade central banks have continuously re‑positioned gold storage, and the current U.S. political environment may push some central banks toward alternative storage sites.

Antar, executive vice president of Brink Co., believes that rising geopolitical and economic uncertainty, together with the growing importance of gold as a strategic reserve asset, are jointly driving this trend.

Schneider, senior researcher at the Qatar Global Issues Middle East Committee, said the Dutch gold transfer is consistent with the practices of Germany, France and Italy over the past decade, aimed at strengthening actual control over national gold reserves. As the United States increasingly uses the dollar, trade relations and international payment systems as policy tools, many countries’ unease deepens.

Donovan, chief economic analyst for wealth management at UBS Global, pointed out that increasing gold liquidity is “not a normal behavior.” Because central banks usually adopt prudent reserve‑management strategies, these adjustments, which revolve around “trust” and signals about the United States’ international reputation, remain highly significant.

The World Gold Council’s ‘2026 Global Central Bank Gold Reserves Survey’ shows that 74% of central‑bank reserve managers expect the dollar’s share of global reserves to decline over the next five years; 84% expect gold’s share to rise, and 45% anticipate increasing gold holdings within the next year. Over the past four years, the scale of gold purchases by central banks has been markedly higher than ten years ago, indicating that the composition of global reserve assets is accelerating change.

items.title: 未發先炒！蘋果iPhone 18新機和摺疊機還未亮相　港版代搶費用先衝破6000
items.title_en: Pre‑launch Hype! Apple iPhone 18 and Foldable Phone Yet to Appear, Hong‑Kong Version Proxy‑Buy Fees Surge Past 6,000
paras: iPhone 18與摺疊機代搶爆火　專家警告：恐淪黑產洗錢工具
蘋果秋季新品發布會將在台灣時間週四(10日)凌晨登場，料將推出iPhone 18系列與首款摺疊手機，但與此同時也引爆中國的代搶業務。
綜合《界面新聞》與在二手平台查詢發現，iPhone 18系列代搶費199至499元，摺疊屏約200至600元，港版更高達1000至1500元。
代搶人員稱需以Apple ID下單，約到後去郵箱付款，「擔心的話去註冊一個新ID，或者買一個，幾塊錢」。註冊新ID需提供手機號、身份證號後四位、付款方式及取機城市；部分代搶還要求提供淘寶、拼多多賬號並登錄搶購。
盤古智庫高級研究員江瀚警告，此舉意味讓渡實名信息、收貨地址甚至支付權限，極易被黑產用於洗錢或詐騙；高頻異地登錄還可能觸發風控封號。私下交易缺乏平台擔保，消費者易「錢貨兩空」。
蘋果秋季發布會將於北京時間9月10日凌晨1點舉行，預計推出iPhone 18 Pro系列及首款摺疊手機iPhone Ultra，也是新任CEO約翰·特努斯上任後首場發布會。
據報蘋果計劃年產800萬至1000萬部摺疊iPhone，但因品控嚴苛，初期日產量僅「數百部」，遠低於目標所需的數萬台。摺疊機需通過更嚴苛的耐久性測試，屏幕平整度與鉸鏈標準更高，量產推遲數周，或推高售價。
受初期產能受限預期影響，蘋果股價連續兩個交易日走低，8日收報316.22美元，跌1.2%。
paras_en: iPhone 18 and the foldable model are sparking a proxy‑buy frenzy, with experts warning they could become tools for illicit money‑laundering.

Apple’s autumn product launch will go live in the early hours of Thursday (the 10th) Taiwan time, expected to unveil the iPhone 18 series and the first foldable phone, while simultaneously igniting a proxy‑buy market in China.

Based on reports from Jiemian News and checks on second‑hand platforms, proxy‑buy fees for the iPhone 18 series range from NT$199 to NT$499, for foldable screens about NT$200 to NT$600, and for the Hong‑Kong version as high as NT$1,000 to NT$1,500.

Proxy‑buyers say you must place the order with an Apple ID, then pay at the post office upon arrival; “if you’re worried, just register a new ID or buy one for a few dollars.” Registering a new ID requires a phone number, the last four digits of an ID card, a payment method and the city for pickup; some proxies also ask for Taobao or Pinduoduo accounts and log‑in credentials to snatch the device.

Pangu Think Tank senior researcher Jiang Han warned that this practice hands over real‑name information, delivery addresses and even payment authority, making it easy for black‑market operators to use for money‑laundering or fraud; high‑frequency logins from different locations could also trigger risk controls and account bans. Private transactions lack platform guarantees, leaving consumers vulnerable to “pay‑and‑receive nothing.”

Apple’s autumn launch will be held at 1 a.m. Beijing time on September 10, expected to debut the iPhone 18 Pro series and the first foldable iPhone Ultra, marking the first event under new CEO John Ternus.

According to reports, Apple plans to produce 8 million to 10 million foldable iPhones annually, but because of strict quality control the initial daily output will be only “a few hundred units,” far below the tens of thousands needed to meet the target. The foldable device must pass tougher durability tests, with higher standards for screen flatness and hinge strength, pushing mass‑production back by several weeks and potentially raising its price.
Apple’s share price fell for two consecutive trading days amid expectations of limited early production capacity, closing at $316.22 on the 8th, down 1.2%.

items.title: 長鑫存儲宣布量產LPDDR6記憶體 搭載於旗艦折疊手機
items.title_en: Changxin Storage Announces Mass Production of LPDDR6 Memory for Flagship Foldable Phone
paras: 中國記憶體廠商長鑫存儲正式宣布量產下一代 LPDDR6 記憶體，並於小米推出的折疊旗艦手機 Xiaomi 18 Fold 完成商用首秀。

在產品規格方面，據報導，該款 LPDDR6 為基於 16Gb 晶粒建構的 16GB 封裝晶片，遵循 JEDEC LPDDR6 標準，採用 1,295 顆焊球（Ball）的 FBGA 封裝。長鑫存儲表示，根據內部測試數據，其最高傳輸速率可達 12,800 Mbps，與系統單晶片（SoC）搭配時運行速率為 10,667 Mbps；相較同速率的 LPDDR5X，峰值頻寬提升 60%，功耗則降低 20%。
技術細節顯示，該晶片採用雙子通道架構與 24-bit 原生 I/O，配置獨立調校預加重與訊號均衡參數。能效管理上引進雙軌 DVFS 與動態效率模式；安全機制則在原有 Link ECC 與 On-Die ECC 基礎上，新增每行啟動計數（PRAC）以抵禦行錘攻擊。此外，封裝使用高導熱 High K EMC 塑封料，使顆粒熱阻下降約 40%。
市場定位與產能方面，市場調查機構 TrendForce 數據顯示，2026 年第二季全球 DRAM 產業營收達1,547.3 億美元，長鑫存儲市占率由第一季的 7.6% 提升至 9.5%，位居全球第四，排在三星（39.4%）、SK 海力士（24.9%）與美光（23.3%）之後。
針對公司發展與合作傳言，長鑫存儲總經理趙綸指出，公司產品在性能、品質與供應穩定度上已具備競爭力，並持續對 HBM 及下一代 DRAM 投入資源。科技媒體 Wccftech 則分析估算，考慮到長鑫存儲產能利用率達 95% 且已被預訂至 2027 年，產能限制可能影響其承接額外潛在訂單的能力。
paras_en: Changxin Storage, a Chinese memory manufacturer, has officially announced the mass production of next‑generation LPDDR6 memory, debuting in Xiaomi’s foldable flagship phone, the Xiaomi 18 Fold.

The LPDDR6 is built on a 16Gb die and packaged as a 16GB chip, following the JEDEC LPDDR6 standard and using a 1,295‑ball FBGA package. According to internal tests, it can reach a peak transfer rate of 12,800 Mbps, and when paired with an SoC it runs at 10,667 Mbps— a 60% increase in peak bandwidth over LPDDR5X at the same speed, while cutting power consumption by 20%.

Technically, the chip employs a dual‑channel architecture with 24‑bit native I/O, and features independently tuned pre‑emphasis and signal‑equalization parameters. It introduces dual‑track DVFS and dynamic efficiency modes for power management, and adds per‑row activation counting (PRAC) on top of existing Link ECC and On‑Die ECC to defend against row hammer attacks. The package uses a high‑thermal‑conductivity High‑K EMC molding compound, reducing die thermal resistance by about 40%.

Market positioning and capacity: TrendForce data shows that global DRAM revenue reached $154.73 billion in Q2 2026, with Changxin’s market share rising from 7.6% in Q1 to 9.5%, placing it fourth worldwide behind Samsung (39.4%), SK Hynix (24.9%) and Micron (23.3%).

Regarding company development and partnership rumors, Changxin’s general manager Zhao Lun stated that the company’s products are competitive in performance, quality, and supply stability, and that it continues to invest in HBM and next‑generation DRAM. Tech media Wccftech estimated that with a 95% capacity utilization and orders booked through 2027, capacity constraints may limit the company’s ability to take on additional potential orders.

items.title: 美中AI戰再升級！美控DeepSeek、阿里「惡意蒸餾」竊取技術
items.title_en: US-China AI War Escalates: US-Controlled DeepSeek and Alibaba 'Malicious Distillation' Steal Technology
paras: 美國國安機構指控，包括DeepSeek與阿里巴巴(09988-HK)在內的中國人工智慧(AI)公司，正系統性從美國先進AI模型取得技術能力，而且相關行為已達工業化規模，目的是降低AI開發成本並縮小技術差距。
根據美國網路安全暨基礎設施安全局(CISA)、國家安全局(NSA)與聯邦調查局(FBI)周二(8日)發布的聯合通報，這些行動很可能是在中國政府知情的情況下進行。
美方表示，自2024年底以來，深度求索(DeepSeek)、阿里巴巴、月之暗面(Moonshot AI)、稀宇科技(MiniMax)(00100-HK)、階躍星辰(StepFun)與Z.ai(02513-HK)，至少已從美國AI模型取得數十億個token，涉及數百萬次互動。
美國機構指出，DeepSeek曾組織性的發動行動，鎖定AI模型的推理能力及特定功能開發R1與V3模型。阿里巴巴則利用工業化規模的「蒸餾」技術，提升Qwen系列模型的能力。
通報指出，這些公司透過多種管道取得模型能力，包括API、雲端服務商、第三方聚合平台，以及被稱為「轉運站」的代理伺服器灰色市場，以規避地理限制與安全防護機制。相關業者也利用假帳號、大量訂閱及自動化系統逃避偵測。
美國機構表示，DeepSeek鎖定的模型包括Claude、Gemini、GPT與Grok，試圖取得推理、程式編寫、代理式AI以及問答最佳化等能力。
美國機構建議AI公司強化對異常使用行為的監控，針對疑似模型蒸餾行為調整回應方式，並促進AI模型業者、雲端平台及API聚合商之間分享情報。
paras_en: The US national security agencies accuse Chinese AI companies, including DeepSeek and Alibaba (09988-HK), of systematically extracting technical capabilities from advanced US AI models, reaching an industrial scale to reduce development costs and narrow the technology gap.

According to a joint notice released Tuesday (8th) by the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), the National Security Agency (NSA), and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), these actions were likely carried out with the knowledge of the Chinese government.

Since the end of 2024, DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot AI, MiniMax (00100-HK), StepFun, and Z.ai (02513-HK) have reportedly extracted billions of tokens from US AI models, involving millions of interactions.

The US agencies noted that DeepSeek orchestrated targeted operations to capture the inference capabilities and specific feature development of R1 and V3 models, while Alibaba employed industrial-scale 'distillation' techniques to enhance the Qwen series models.

The report states that these companies obtained model capabilities through multiple channels, including APIs, cloud service providers, third‑party aggregation platforms, and gray‑market proxy servers known as 'transit stations', to bypass geographic restrictions and security mechanisms. They also used fake accounts, bulk subscriptions, and automated systems to evade detection.
DeepSeek targeted models such as Claude, Gemini, GPT, and Grok, attempting to acquire inference, programming, agent-based AI, and question‑answer optimization capabilities.

The agencies recommend that AI companies strengthen monitoring of anomalous usage, adjust responses to suspected model‑distillation activities, and promote intelligence sharing among AI model providers, cloud platforms, and API aggregators.

items.title: PCB股強勁反彈！009828掛牌1周規模翻倍 穩居成交前十
items.title_en: PCB Stocks Surge! 009828 Doubles in Size Within a Week of Listing, Ranks in Top Ten by Volume
paras: 9 月 2 日掛牌上市的中信台日韓 PCB(009828-TW)，甫上市便展現強勁吸金實力。不僅連續多日成交量穩居台灣ETF市場前十名，更在掛牌僅一周多時間內，統計至9/8，該檔ETF規模快速攀升至61.6億元，相較募集期間規模成長高達91.3%，成為近期ETF市場最受矚目的新秀之一。法人表示，隨著第四季傳統旺季來臨，加上 AI 伺服器出貨動能升溫，PCB 產業後續表現值得關注。
市場觀察指出，新ETF上市後是否能持續獲得市場青睞，成交量往往是重要指標之一。009828自掛牌以來成交量始終維持高檔水準，每個交易日皆名列全市場ETF成交量前十強，顯示不論是看好PCB產業長期成長趨勢的投資人，或是短中期資金布局AI供應鏈的買盤，都持續湧入。
法人分析，009828受到高度關注，主因在於其聚焦全球AI發展下最成長潛力的PCB產業鏈。過去市場談到AI投資，多將焦點集中於GPU等AI晶片，但隨著AI應用快速普及，投資重心已逐步擴張至整體AI基礎建設，進一步帶動高階PCB、ABF載板及相關材料需求持續升溫。
尤其從800G交換器邁向1.6T高速傳輸時代後，對於高層數、高頻高速PCB的需求明顯增加，不論是AI伺服器主板、交換器、網通設備、光模組或封裝載板，產品規格升級都帶動單位價值提升，也讓供應鏈進入新一波成長循環。
此外，市場先前對產業的疑慮已逐漸消化，投資焦點重回基本面。受惠AI伺服器需求成長、高階材料供給趨緊，以及大型雲端業者資本支出持續增加，高階PCB及載板供應鏈營運展望持續升溫。
載板大廠欣興昨(8)日甫發布8月自結營收達177.46億元，年成長56%，主要受惠ABF載板需求強勁、漲價效應發酵及AI伺服器相關板材銷貨動能增溫，亮眼營收也反映了AI相關需求仍維持強勁動能，市場對PCB產業發展看法依舊正向。
值得注意的是，009828最大的特色，在於一次納入台灣、日本與韓國三地PCB產業鏈龍頭企業。除了台灣的欣興、南電、台光電、台燿、金像電等指標企業外，也涵蓋日本高階材料與設備廠，以及韓國先進PCB與載板相關供應鏈，投資範圍較單純布局台股PCB個股更加完整。
中信台日韓PCB(009828-TW)經理人葉松炫表示，目前全球AI資料中心建設仍處於高速擴張階段，各大雲端服務商持續提高資本支出，而PCB正是AI伺服器升級過程中不可或缺的關鍵零組件之一。隨著GB300、下一代AI伺服器平台陸續導入，市場預期PCB產業有望持續受惠於規格升級與產值提升雙重利多。

paras_en: On September 2, the China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF (009828‑TW) debuted on the market and immediately demonstrated strong capital inflow. Not only has its daily trading volume consistently ranked among the top ten in Taiwan’s ETF market, but within just over a week of listing—by September 8—the fund’s assets have surged to NT$6.16 billion, a 91.3% increase from the fundraising period, making it one of the most watched newcomers in the recent ETF space. Institutional investors note that with the traditional Q4 season approaching and AI server shipments heating up, the PCB industry’s outlook merits attention.

Since its debut, 009828’s trading volume has remained at a high level, placing it in the top ten ETFs by daily turnover every trading day. This indicates that both investors who are bullish on the long‑term growth of the PCB sector and those allocating short‑ to medium‑term capital to the AI supply chain continue to pour in.

Analysts point out that 009828 draws intense interest because it focuses on the PCB supply chain with the highest growth potential under global AI development. While AI investment discussions have traditionally centered on GPUs and other AI chips, the rapid proliferation of AI applications is shifting investment focus toward the broader AI infrastructure, driving sustained demand for advanced PCBs, ABF substrates and related materials.

Especially as the industry moves from 800 Gbps switches to the 1.6 Tbps high‑speed transmission era, demand for multi‑layer, high‑frequency PCBs has risen sharply. Whether for AI server motherboards, switches, networking gear, optical modules or packaging substrates, upgraded product specifications lift unit values and usher the supply chain into a new growth cycle.

Moreover, earlier market concerns about the sector have largely been digested, returning investor focus to fundamentals. Benefiting from growing AI server demand, tighter supply of high‑end materials, and continued cap‑ex from large cloud providers, the outlook for advanced PCBs and substrate supply chains remains increasingly positive.

Substrate leader Unimicron reported on August 8 that its August self‑reported revenue reached NT$17.746 billion, up 56% year‑over‑year, driven by strong ABF substrate demand, price‑increase effects and rising sales of AI‑server‑related boards. The impressive revenue underscores that AI‑related demand remains robust, and market sentiment toward the PCB industry stays upbeat.

A notable feature of 009828 is its inclusion of leading PCB companies from Taiwan, Japan and South Korea. In addition to Taiwanese benchmarks such as Unimicron, Nan Ya, Taiwan Photonics, Tai Yao and Kingboard, the ETF also covers high‑end material and equipment firms in Japan and advanced PCB and substrate suppliers in Korea, offering a more comprehensive exposure than a simple Taiwan PCB stock allocation.

Fund manager Yeh Song‑hsuan of China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB (009828‑TW) said that global AI data‑center construction is still in a rapid expansion phase, with major cloud providers continuously increasing cap‑ex. PCBs are a critical component in AI server upgrades. As GB300 and next‑generation AI server platforms are rolled out, the market expects the PCB industry to benefit from both specification upgrades and higher output values.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉開高震盪走低守住4萬7  量縮小漲77點市場觀望態度濃厚
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market After Hours: Opens Higher, Fluctuates Down, Holds 47,000; Volume Shrinks, Gains 77 Points, Market Cautious
paras: 台股今(9)日開盤在電子權值股領軍下，一度上漲超過442點，盤中在權王台積電(2330-TW)由紅翻黑下，指數一度翻黑，盤面上以面板、光學、塑化表現較佳，金融股則表現較為疲軟，尾盤在權值股回神下，終場小漲77.58點或0.16％，收47,183.36點，守住4萬7千點關卡，成交量再縮減至7,735.06億元。
權值股部分，台積電(2330-TW)開高走低，最後一盤在大單敲進3,360張下、小跌0.2％，收2,465元；聯發科(2454-TW)跌1.8％、鴻海(2317-TW)漲0.2％、廣達(2382-TW)受惠AI伺服器營收爆發，漲4.27％；聯電(2303-TW)漲3.28％。
面板股得利於智慧顯示器衝高，迎接第4季消費性電子出貨旺季，包括友達(2409-TW)、群創(3481-TW)、彩晶(6116-TW)漲幅逾2-3％。
光學股受惠於蘋果發表會明登場，光學鏡頭股多檔期漲，龍頭股大立光(3008-TW)、伯特光(6859-TW)大漲半根停板，玉晶光(3008-TW)漲停板創新高價，聯一光(3441-TW)強漲8.7％，揚明光(3504-TW)、亞光(3019-TW)漲逾3％。
塑化股受惠中東戰事持續延燒，加上進入金九銀十的傳統旺季，與油價高度相關的台塑化(6505-TW)表現最為強勁，開高走高，收漲停板，創近1個多月以來新高價；二線塑化股因基期較低，包括國喬(1312-TW)漲半根停板，亞聚(1308-TW)、台達化(1309-TW)、台聚(1304-TW)、台苯(1310-TW)漲幅超過3-4％，華夏(1305-TW)、台塑(1301-TW)漲2％。
分析師表示，美國本周即將公告CPI指數，將會影響美國聯準會是否升息，關鍵點在於美伊戰爭是否持續升溫緊張，也讓今日原油期貨上揚，加上近日交易量持續縮減至兆元以下，也讓市場資金持觀望態度。展望後市，可觀察台股成交量是否能持續放大量能，建議投資人漲多股票可先行獲利入袋，待拉回後，再逢低進場布局。
paras_en: The Taiwan market opened today (the 9th) led by heavyweight electronics stocks, briefly climbing more than 442 points. Mid‑session, the benchmark TSMC (2330‑TW) turned from red to black, causing the index to dip into negative territory. Panels, optics and plastics performed relatively well, while financials were weaker. In the final minutes, heavyweight stocks recovered, and the market closed modestly up 77.58 points, or 0.16%, at 47,183.36 points, preserving the 47‑thousand‑point threshold. Turnover fell further to NT$7,735.06 billion.

Among the heavyweight stocks, TSMC (2330‑TW) opened higher but fell, ending the session with a large order of 3,360 lots, down 0.2% to NT$2,465. MediaTek (2454‑TW) slipped 1.8%, Hon Hai (2317‑TW) rose 0.2%, and Quanta (2382‑TW) jumped 4.27% on booming AI‑server revenue. UMC (2303‑TW) gained 3.28%.

Panel makers benefited from a surge in smart‑display demand ahead of the Q4 consumer‑electronics shipping season. AU Optronics (2409‑TW), Innolux (3481‑TW) and CTC (6116‑TW) each rose between 2% and 3%.

Optics stocks were buoyed by Apple’s upcoming product launch, with many lens makers posting gains. Leaders Largan Precision (3008‑TW) and Betta Optical (6859‑TW) surged half a board‑limit, while Yujing Optical (3008‑TW) hit a new high on a full‑limit rise. Lianyi Optical (3441‑TW) jumped 8.7%, and Yangming Optical (3504‑TW) and Asia Optical (3019‑TW) each climbed over 3%.

Plastics and chemicals were helped by the ongoing Middle‑East conflict and the traditional “golden September, silver October” season. Petrochemical giant Formosa Plastics (6505‑TW) was the strongest, opening higher and closing at a limit‑up price, a new high in over a month. Second‑tier plastics stocks, starting from lower bases, also rose: Guojiao (1312‑TW) hit a half‑limit rise, while Yaqi (1308‑TW), Delta Chemical (1309‑TW), Taiwan Poly (1304‑TW) and Taiwan Benzene (1310‑TW) gained 3‑4%; Huaxia (1305‑TW) and Formosa (1301‑TW) each rose about 2%.

Analysts note that the U.S. will release its CPI this week, which could influence the Fed’s rate‑hike decision. The key factor is whether the US‑Iran tension escalates, a factor that lifted crude futures today. With trading volume shrinking to below a trillion NT dollars, market participants remain cautious. Looking ahead, observers will watch whether Taiwan’s turnover can sustain higher levels; investors are advised to lock in profits on rallying stocks and consider re‑entering on pull‑backs.

items.title: 力成(6239) FOPLP良率突破90%！500億資本支出砸下去，下一步才是關鍵？
paras: 力成(6239-TW)近期突破性進展，其一為8月底法說會揭露FOPLP技術細節、良率高於95%且產能已被客戶鎖定，其二為2026年8月單月營收85.58億元創歷史新高，年增24.5%，AI與記憶體需求雙引擎發威。激情過後，2027年量產能轉為實質營收嗎?

8月營收創歷史新高，記憶體本業先幫AI封裝撐腰
在FOPLP還沒有大量貢獻之前，力成的主要獲利支撐仍來自既有記憶體封測業務。2026年8月營收達85.58億元，月增3.47%、年增24.45%，創下歷史新高。而且這已經是連續兩個月刷新單月營收紀錄。背後主要受惠於AI相關記憶體需求，包括HBM外溢、SSD與DDR5等產品需求提升。

FOPLP量產進入倒數，良率已突破90%！
力成目前積極布局的FOPLP，是未來AI高階封裝的重要技術之一。相較於傳統12吋晶圓製程，面板級封裝可以利用更大的面積進行晶片封裝，有機會提高單片產出、降低成本，因此特別受到AI大型晶片市場關注。
力成竹科P11廠的FOPLP產線目前已完成建置，總投資規模約500億元，可以提供從前段RDL、晶片貼合，到後段封裝的一站式服務。更重要的是，目前FOPLP良率已達90%～95%，已超越先前設定的90%目標，實體樣品也已經送交客戶驗證。

5倍光罩已經上線，2026年底再挑戰9倍
除了良率之外，FOPLP另一個關鍵就是大型面板製程與設備能力。力成目前已具備5倍光罩尺寸的生產能力，若採用約515mm × 510mm的面板製程，單片可以產出約45顆晶片。相比12吋晶圓一次約只能產出8～9顆，單片產出明顯提高。
而力成的設備布局還在持續擴大。目前5倍光罩尺寸已可生產，預計2026年底設備進一步提升至9倍光罩尺寸，未來再朝14倍光罩尺寸擴充。

AMD、博通加持，FOPLP不只是技術題材
如果單純只有「良率突破90%」，市場未必會給太高評價。真正讓FOPLP受到關注的，是客戶與合作夥伴已經開始進場。市場資訊顯示，AMD已導入力成FOPLP作為核心CPU Venice相關封裝平台；另一方面，力成也與博通在新加坡成立合資公司，投資規模達4億美元，規劃分4年投入。
這兩項布局代表的意義不同：

AMD：代表FOPLP開始進入HPC／AI高階晶片封裝應用。
博通：代表力成有機會透過合資模式，進一步綁定高階AI ASIC封裝需求。

尤其當AI晶片持續放大，而先進封裝產能供應仍吃緊時，市場確實需要台積電以外的第二封裝來源。因此，力成這幾年的FOPLP布局，開始從「長期技術投資」逐漸走向「商業化收成」。

500億元資本支出押注FOPLP，2027年才是真正驗收期
雖然FOPLP長線題材強，但力成目前仍有幾項風險需要留意。
首先，FOPLP量產進度仍需要客戶驗證，目前技術與良率雖已達到一定水準，但從樣品到大規模量產仍存在時間差。
其次，力成目前把大量資本集中到FOPLP，因此部分HBM、CIS新案暫緩開發。如果FOPLP放量速度不如預期，高資本支出反而可能增加短期折舊與資金壓力。
最後則是新產能的實際稼動率。設備到位只是第一步，真正決定投資效益的，是客戶訂單能否快速填滿產能。
力成現在最大的轉變，是公司已經逐步從傳統記憶體封測，跨向AI先進封裝。目前FOPLP已經具備：良率突破90% → 5倍光罩量產 → 9倍設備擴充 → 客戶驗證 → AI大廠合作
如果2027年能順利進入量產，並且AMD、博通等高階客戶需求持續放量，那麼FOPLP就有機會從目前的「技術與題材」，逐步變成力成新的AI營收成長引擎。

items.title: PCB股強勁反彈！009828掛牌1周規模翻倍 穩居成交前十
items.title_en: PCB Stocks Surge! 009828 Doubles in Size Within a Week of Listing, Ranks in Top Ten by Volume
paras: 9 月 2 日掛牌上市的中信台日韓 PCB(009828-TW)，甫上市便展現強勁吸金實力。不僅連續多日成交量穩居台灣ETF市場前十名，更在掛牌僅一周多時間內，統計至9/8，該檔ETF規模快速攀升至61.6億元，相較募集期間規模成長高達91.3%，成為近期ETF市場最受矚目的新秀之一。法人表示，隨著第四季傳統旺季來臨，加上 AI 伺服器出貨動能升溫，PCB 產業後續表現值得關注。
市場觀察指出，新ETF上市後是否能持續獲得市場青睞，成交量往往是重要指標之一。009828自掛牌以來成交量始終維持高檔水準，每個交易日皆名列全市場ETF成交量前十強，顯示不論是看好PCB產業長期成長趨勢的投資人，或是短中期資金布局AI供應鏈的買盤，都持續湧入。
法人分析，009828受到高度關注，主因在於其聚焦全球AI發展下最成長潛力的PCB產業鏈。過去市場談到AI投資，多將焦點集中於GPU等AI晶片，但隨著AI應用快速普及，投資重心已逐步擴張至整體AI基礎建設，進一步帶動高階PCB、ABF載板及相關材料需求持續升溫。
尤其從800G交換器邁向1.6T高速傳輸時代後，對於高層數、高頻高速PCB的需求明顯增加，不論是AI伺服器主板、交換器、網通設備、光模組或封裝載板，產品規格升級都帶動單位價值提升，也讓供應鏈進入新一波成長循環。
此外，市場先前對產業的疑慮已逐漸消化，投資焦點重回基本面。受惠AI伺服器需求成長、高階材料供給趨緊，以及大型雲端業者資本支出持續增加，高階PCB及載板供應鏈營運展望持續升溫。
載板大廠欣興昨(8)日甫發布8月自結營收達177.46億元，年成長56%，主要受惠ABF載板需求強勁、漲價效應發酵及AI伺服器相關板材銷貨動能增溫，亮眼營收也反映了AI相關需求仍維持強勁動能，市場對PCB產業發展看法依舊正向。
值得注意的是，009828最大的特色，在於一次納入台灣、日本與韓國三地PCB產業鏈龍頭企業。除了台灣的欣興、南電、台光電、台燿、金像電等指標企業外，也涵蓋日本高階材料與設備廠，以及韓國先進PCB與載板相關供應鏈，投資範圍較單純布局台股PCB個股更加完整。
中信台日韓PCB(009828-TW)經理人葉松炫表示，目前全球AI資料中心建設仍處於高速擴張階段，各大雲端服務商持續提高資本支出，而PCB正是AI伺服器升級過程中不可或缺的關鍵零組件之一。隨著GB300、下一代AI伺服器平台陸續導入，市場預期PCB產業有望持續受惠於規格升級與產值提升雙重利多。

paras_en: On September 2, the China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF (009828‑TW) debuted on the market and immediately demonstrated strong capital inflow. Not only has its daily trading volume consistently ranked among the top ten in Taiwan’s ETF market, but within just over a week of listing—by September 8—the fund’s assets have surged to NT$6.16 billion, a 91.3% increase from the fundraising period, making it one of the most watched newcomers in the recent ETF space. Institutional investors note that with the traditional Q4 season approaching and AI server shipments heating up, the PCB industry’s outlook merits attention.

Since its debut, 009828’s trading volume has remained at a high level, placing it in the top ten ETFs by daily turnover every trading day. This indicates that both investors who are bullish on the long‑term growth of the PCB sector and those allocating short‑ to medium‑term capital to the AI supply chain continue to pour in.

Analysts point out that 009828 draws intense interest because it focuses on the PCB supply chain with the highest growth potential under global AI development. While AI investment discussions have traditionally centered on GPUs and other AI chips, the rapid proliferation of AI applications is shifting investment focus toward the broader AI infrastructure, driving sustained demand for advanced PCBs, ABF substrates and related materials.

Especially as the industry moves from 800 Gbps switches to the 1.6 Tbps high‑speed transmission era, demand for multi‑layer, high‑frequency PCBs has risen sharply. Whether for AI server motherboards, switches, networking gear, optical modules or packaging substrates, upgraded product specifications lift unit values and usher the supply chain into a new growth cycle.

Moreover, earlier market concerns about the sector have largely been digested, returning investor focus to fundamentals. Benefiting from growing AI server demand, tighter supply of high‑end materials, and continued cap‑ex from large cloud providers, the outlook for advanced PCBs and substrate supply chains remains increasingly positive.

Substrate leader Unimicron reported on August 8 that its August self‑reported revenue reached NT$17.746 billion, up 56% year‑over‑year, driven by strong ABF substrate demand, price‑increase effects and rising sales of AI‑server‑related boards. The impressive revenue underscores that AI‑related demand remains robust, and market sentiment toward the PCB industry stays upbeat.

A notable feature of 009828 is its inclusion of leading PCB companies from Taiwan, Japan and South Korea. In addition to Taiwanese benchmarks such as Unimicron, Nan Ya, Taiwan Photonics, Tai Yao and Kingboard, the ETF also covers high‑end material and equipment firms in Japan and advanced PCB and substrate suppliers in Korea, offering a more comprehensive exposure than a simple Taiwan PCB stock allocation.

Fund manager Yeh Song‑hsuan of China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB (009828‑TW) said that global AI data‑center construction is still in a rapid expansion phase, with major cloud providers continuously increasing cap‑ex. PCBs are a critical component in AI server upgrades. As GB300 and next‑generation AI server platforms are rolled out, the market expects the PCB industry to benefit from both specification upgrades and higher output values.

items.title: GDP成長創39年高峰背後隱憂！龔明鑫示警：留住45歲「女力」才能撐起產業未來
items.title_en: GDP Growth Hits 39-Year High Amid Hidden Risks! Minister Gong Ming‑Xin Warns: Retaining Women at Age 45 Is Key to the Industry's Future
paras: 經濟部長龔明鑫今（9）日出席台灣女董事協會舉辦的「前瞻布局 韌性承啟 2026剛柔並濟大未來」論壇時表示，近年台灣經濟表現亮眼，女性貢獻功不可沒，甚至占整體經濟成長貢獻的一半。他強調台灣今年GDP年增率可望創39年來的高峰，但榮績的背後也同時藏著勞動市場的隱憂，主因來自女性勞動參與率在45歲後明顯下滑，往往因肩負照顧長輩等家庭責任而退出職場，政府正積極研議相關措施，希望留住產業最重要的「關鍵女力」。
台灣女董事協會與安永聯合會計師事務所並於今日共同發布《2026女性治理白皮書》，並邀集超過300位上市櫃女性董事、女性CEO及專業經理人參與論壇，聚焦女性領導力、企業治理與永續發展等議題。
龔明鑫致詞時指出，台灣去年經濟成長率達8.76%，今年有望突破11%，創下39年來新高紀錄，這項成果是全民共同努力的結果，其中女性更扮演不可或缺的推動力量。他表示，根據經濟部《中小企業白皮書》資料顯示，女性擔任中小企業負責人或領導人的比例已達約38%，逼近4成，展現女性在企業經營上的影響力持續提升。
他進一步指出，不只在中小企業領域，金融業、生技產業以及上市櫃公司治理層面，近年女性主管與決策者占比也持續攀升。包括前總統蔡英文成為台灣首位女性國家領導人，以及許多企業ESG策略由女性高階主管主導推動，都凸顯女性領導人細膩、包容及重視永續的特質，已成為企業競爭力的重要來源。
龔明鑫也提到，經濟部次長近日出席APEC相關會議時，女性賦權及提升女性就業力仍是各會員體高度關注議題。對台灣而言，除了中小企業與資訊科技產業外，女性發展議題也是具有國際影響力的重要倡議領域。
然而，在少子化與高齡化雙重壓力下，台灣女性勞參率與男性仍存在落差，尤其45歲以後下降速度明顯高於其他年齡層。他分析，許多女性在職涯發展最成熟、最有機會晉升高階主管或接班人的階段，卻同時面臨照顧父母長輩以及家庭責任的壓力，被迫中斷職涯。
「45歲其實是企業領導人才養成最重要的時刻，」龔明鑫表示，無論男性或女性，這個年齡層往往已具備成熟管理經驗與決策能力，但不少女性卻因照護需求而離開職場，減少了成為企業領導人的機會，也讓企業流失珍貴人才。
因此，政府正持續思考如何減輕女性家庭照護負擔，包括透過長照資源、友善職場及彈性工作制度等方向著手，盼提高中高齡女性勞動參與率，讓更多女性能夠持續投入管理職與決策圈，發揮專業能力。
龔明鑫也指出，近年不少企業二代接班人是女性，不僅展現創新思維，也具備全球視野與韌性治理能力，在面對國際情勢變化及產業轉型時更能展現優勢。他期待未來有更多女性與跨世代人才投入企業決策層，持續為台灣產業創新、永續發展與國際競爭力注入新動能。
談及AI浪潮帶來的挑戰與機會，龔明鑫也幽默表示，自己最大的壓力是未來大家討論的結果會不會變成「根本不需要男性」，引起台下一片笑聲。不過，他強調，未來產業發展需要的是多元人才共同參與，而女性力量正是台灣邁向下一階段成長不可或缺的關鍵。
paras_en: Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑Xin attended the Taiwan Women Directors Association’s forum “Forward‑looking Layout, Resilient Initiation: A Strong and Flexible Future for 2026” today, noting that Taiwan’s recent economic performance has been impressive and women have contributed indispensably, accounting for about half of overall growth. He stressed that Taiwan’s GDP annual growth rate this year could reach a 39‑year peak, but that this success masks labor‑market concerns, chiefly the sharp drop in women’s labor‑force participation after age 45 as many leave the workforce to care for elderly relatives. The government is actively studying measures to retain this crucial “female power” for industry.

The Taiwan Women Directors Association and Ernst & Young jointly released the “2026 Women Governance White Paper” today, gathering over 300 female board members, CEOs and professional managers from listed companies to discuss women’s leadership, corporate governance and sustainability.

In his remarks, Gong pointed out that Taiwan’s economic growth rate was 8.76% last year and is expected to exceed 11% this year, a 39‑year record, a result of collective effort with women playing an essential driving role. He cited the Ministry’s Small‑and‑Medium Enterprise White Paper, which shows women now account for about 38% of SME owners or leaders, approaching 40% and highlighting their growing influence in business management.

He added that beyond SMEs, the share of female executives and decision‑makers in finance, biotech and listed‑company governance has also been rising. The election of former President Tsai Ing‑wen as Taiwan’s first female head of state and the fact that many corporate ESG strategies are led by senior women underscore women’s nuanced, inclusive and sustainability‑focused leadership as a source of competitive advantage.

Gong noted that the Deputy Minister of Economic Affairs recently attended an APEC meeting where women’s empowerment and employment were high‑priority topics for member economies. For Taiwan, women’s development is an internationally influential advocacy area alongside SMEs and the ICT sector.

However, under the twin pressures of low birth rates and an aging population, Taiwan’s female labor‑force participation still lags behind men’s, especially after age 45 where the decline is markedly steeper. He explained that many women at the peak of their careers—when promotion to senior roles or succession is most likely—face simultaneous pressures to care for aging parents and family, forcing career interruptions.

“Age 45 is actually the most critical moment for cultivating corporate leadership talent,” Gong said. Whether male or female, people at this age usually have mature management experience and decision‑making ability, yet many women leave the workforce due to caregiving duties, reducing their chances to become leaders and causing firms to lose valuable talent.

Consequently, the government is exploring ways to lessen women’s family‑care burden, such as expanding long‑term care resources, promoting family‑friendly workplaces and flexible work arrangements, aiming to raise labor participation among middle‑aged and older women so more can stay in managerial and decision‑making roles.

Gong also observed that many second‑generation successors in firms are women, who bring innovative thinking, global perspectives and resilient governance, giving companies an edge amid international shifts and industry transformation. He looks forward to more women and cross‑generational talent joining corporate decision‑making to inject new momentum into Taiwan’s innovation, sustainability and global competitiveness.

Discussing the AI wave’s challenges and opportunities, Gong joked that his biggest pressure is whether future debates will conclude that “men are no longer needed,” eliciting laughter from the audience. He emphasized, however, that future industry development requires diverse talent working together, and women’s strength is an indispensable key for Taiwan’s next stage of growth.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉穩懋8月營收創56個月新高 盤中大漲超過半根停板
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Wenmao's August Revenue Hits a 56-Month High, Shares Surge Over Half a Board Limit Intraday
paras: 三五族PA大廠穩懋(3105-TW)受惠於蘋果(AAPL-US)即將在本周四(10日) 凌晨舉行秋季新品發表會，預計將發布蘋果首款摺疊iPhone、iPhone 18 Pro系列手機也成為一大焦點，穩懋預期受惠訂單拉貨利多，加上8月營收19.37億元、月增2.4％、年增30.6％，創近56個月來新高，也激勵穩懋今(9)日開高走高，盤中一度大漲8％以上。
穩懋8月營收年月雙增，今(2026)年前8月營收年增33.01％，市場對砷化鎵代工本業動能與營收、毛利率預期偏向樂觀，主要因光通訊及美系高階手機相關需求被視為下半年成長主軸，也帶動穩懋中長期多頭預期持續增溫。
展望今(2026)年，穩懋在美系客戶高階手機發表及光通新產品步入量產，公司預期第3季單季合併營收將季增低雙位數百分比(11%-13%)，合併毛利率預計約low-thirties(31%-33%)。
此外，穩懋隨著1.6T光通訊產品出貨進一步擴大，加上低軌衛星需求升溫，AI相關光通訊占比已從去(2025)年低個位數倍增至今年高個位數，明(2027)年可望達雙位數成長，將成為穩懋為來的成長主引擎，公司對今年下半年看法審慎樂觀看待。
paras_en: Taiwan's PA giant Wenmao (3105-TW) is set to benefit from Apple's (AAPL-US) upcoming autumn product launch on Thursday (the 10th) early morning, where the tech giant is expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone and the iPhone 18 Pro series, both becoming major focal points. Wenmao anticipates a boost from order pull‑in, and with August revenue of NT$1.937 billion—a 2.4% month‑over‑month increase and a 30.6% year‑over‑year rise, the highest in nearly 56 months—the stock opened higher on the 9th and surged more than 8% intraday.

Wenmao posted double‑digit growth in both revenue and profit for August; year‑to‑date revenue for 2026 is up 33.01% versus the prior year. The market remains optimistic about the momentum of its gallium arsenide (GaAs) foundry business, revenue and gross‑margin outlook, mainly because demand from optical communications and high‑end U.S. smartphones is seen as the growth engine for the second half of the year, further warming long‑term bullish expectations for Wenmao.

Looking ahead in 2026, Wenmao expects that the launch of high‑end smartphones for its U.S. customers and the mass production of new optical‑communication products will drive a single‑quarter revenue increase of low‑double‑digit percentages (11%‑13%) in Q3, with consolidated gross margins projected in the low‑thirties (31%‑33%).

In addition, as Wenmao expands shipments of its 1.6‑terabit optical‑communication products and low‑earth‑orbit satellite demand heats up, the share of AI‑related optical communications has risen from low single‑digit percentages in 2025 to high single‑digit percentages this year and is expected to reach double‑digit growth in 2027, becoming the company's future growth engine. The firm views the second half of the year with cautious optimism.

items.title_en: Jiaji (6715) Raises NT$1.86 B to Bet on AI Optical Communications! NPO and LPO Volume Expected Soon, Will 2027 Bring a Profit Explosion?
paras:
嘉基現增18.6億元重押AI光通訊，NPO成最大亮點
嘉基科技(6715-TW)是嘉澤(3533-TW)的子公司，在AI 伺服器與高速傳輸浪潮中扮演著關鍵的角色。嘉基近期完成現金增資，募得約18.6億元，再加上自有資金後，整體投入資金超過26億元，大舉擴充中壢廠無塵室與AI光通訊產線。
嘉基這次籌資主要用於中壢廠無塵室整建與新產線設備購置，鎖定NPO Socket、800G 嵌入式光學傳輸模組、光引擎模組及400G/800G LPO Optics等產品。時程上，無塵室預計2027年2季完成整建，新產線則在2027年第4季正式投產。

新產線2027年投產，NPO、LPO進度到哪了？
目前進度來看，NPO Socket已進入客戶認證、PAM 400G LPO已小量量生產、800G LPO在送樣階段。大客戶對NPO 釋出正向展望，預期2026年底前可開始有實質貢獻，2027年將是光通訊業績落地的元年。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

8月營收年增113%，但獲利還沒跟上

嘉基近期營收確實出現明顯回升。2026年8月營收約1.65億元，年增113.01%，累計年增率也轉正至10.24%。主要受惠於監視器TH線材滲透率提升，帶動拉貨動能回溫。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
不過，如果進一步拆解季度財報，就會發現嘉基目前仍處於產品轉型與新產線投入的過渡期。2026年第1季毛利率還有40.01%，到了第2季卻快速降至23.24%，營益率也由正轉負。主要原因包括新品投入成本較高，以及目前營收規模還不足以攤平相關費用。所以嘉基營收開始回溫，但真正高毛利的AI光通訊產品，還沒有全面放量。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

2027年能否迎來獲利大爆發？三個關鍵要觀察
01｜NPO認證能否順利通過—目前NPO Socket仍在客戶認證階段
如果認證進度不如預期，後續量產時程就可能往後延，進而影響2027年的營收貢獻。

02｜新產線投產後—營收能否快速放量
嘉基中壢廠無塵室預計2027年第2季完成，新產線則預計第4季投產。投產後，客戶訂單能不能同步跟上，讓新增產能快速轉換成營收。否則在折舊、人事與設備等固定成本增加下，短期反而可能繼續壓縮獲利。

03｜AI光通訊能否取代消費電子波動
嘉基過去仍受到消費性電子需求影響，2025年營收下滑25.1%，因此未來市場會更關注AI光通訊營收占比提升的速度。如果NPO、LPO與CPO逐步放量，嘉基就有機會降低對傳統消費性產品的依賴，讓營收結構出現改變。

paras_en: Jiaji Technology (6715-TW), a subsidiary of Jiaze (3533-TW), plays a key role in the AI server and high‑speed transmission wave. Jiaji recently completed a cash capital increase, raising about NT$1.86 billion. Combined with its own funds, total investment exceeds NT$2.6 billion, used to massively expand the cleanroom at its Zhongli plant and the AI optical‑communication production line.

The funds raised this time will mainly be used for the complete renovation of the Zhongli cleanroom and the purchase of equipment for the new production line, targeting NPO sockets, 800G embedded optical transmission modules, optical engine modules and 400G/800G LPO optics. The cleanroom is slated for completion in Q2 2027, while the new line is scheduled to start production in Q4 2027.

With the new line set to start in 2027, where do NPO and LPO stand? Currently, the NPO socket has entered customer qualification, PAM 400G LPO is in small‑scale production, and 800G LPO is in the sample‑delivery stage. Major customers have expressed a positive outlook for NPO, expecting substantive contributions before the end of 2026, making 2027 the first year that optical‑communication revenue materializes.
(Source: You Analysis Industry Database)

Revenue in August rose 113% year‑over‑year, but profit has not kept pace. Jiaji’s recent revenue shows a clear rebound. August 2026 revenue was about NT$165 million, up 113.01% YoY, and the cumulative annual growth turned positive to 10.24%. The boost came mainly from higher penetration of monitor TH cables, reviving order momentum.
(Source: You Analysis Industry Database)

However, a deeper look at the quarterly reports reveals that Jiaji is still in a transition period of product transformation and new‑line investment. Gross margin was 40.01% in Q1 2026 but fell sharply to 23.24% in Q2, and operating margin turned from positive to negative. The main reasons are the high cost of new product投入 and insufficient revenue scale to spread those costs. Thus revenue is warming up, but the high‑margin AI optical‑communication products have not yet been fully ramped up.
(Source: You Analysis Industry Database)

Can 2027 bring a profit explosion? Three key points to watch: 01 | Will NPO certification pass smoothly—NPO sockets are still in customer qualification. If certification lags, mass‑production timing may be delayed, affecting 2027 revenue contribution.

02 | After the new line starts—Will revenue scale quickly? The Zhongli cleanroom is expected to be finished in Q2 2027, with the new line in Q4. After commissioning, can customer orders keep pace to convert the added capacity into revenue? Otherwise, higher depreciation, personnel and equipment costs could compress profit in the short term.

03 | Can AI optical communications offset consumer‑electronics volatility? Jiaji has historically been affected by consumer‑electronics demand, with revenue dropping 25.1% in 2025. Future market focus will be on how fast AI optical‑communication revenue share rises. If NPO, LPO and CPO volumes increase gradually, Jiaji could reduce reliance on traditional consumer products and reshape its revenue structure.
